facts.fact: MIXP's own public route-server looking glass shows the Mauritius Internet Exchange Point operating, with Route Server 1 (IPv6) reporting 428 days of uptime, last reconfigured 2026-06-15, and about 26 member BGP sessions listed (Emtel, Vodacom, CMC Networks, Canal+ Telecom, PCH and others).

Internet Society Pulse, from PeeringDB data of May 2026, lists the Mauritius Internet Exchange Point (MIXP) in Ebene with 19 members, 95 Gbps cumulative port capacity, and 15 of 19 members peering at the route server.

Internet Society Pulse, from PeeringDB data of May 2026, shows MIXP members registered abroad: 2 in the United States (PCH AS42 and AS3856), 2 in South Africa (CMC Networks, Vodacom) and 1 in Guadeloupe (Canal+ Telecom), against 14 in Mauritius.

The African Union Commission, with Mauritius's Ministry of Technology, Communication and Innovation, officially operationalised the Internet Exchange Point in Mauritius on 26 August 2015 under the AXIS project.

facts.fact: Internet Society Pulse's IXP Tracker lists 1 active exchange point in Mauritius with 22 members as of November 2026.
The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for Mauritius: MIXP, Ebene.

Internet Society Pulse says Mauritius recorded gains in reported IXP memberships and coverage between March 2019 and March 2026 without a rise in its reported IXP count, which shows networks as members of a reported exchange.
